# Every alias craze's catalog has shipped deprecated (plan 050 C1;
# RELEASING.md "Model catalog changes"), one line each: the alias, a space,
# and the craze version internal/version.Version held (the last release) in
# the commit that deprecated it — "fireworks/kimi-k3 0.2.0".
#
# APPEND-ONLY: never delete or edit a line. TestDeprecationHistory requires a
# line for every deprecated model, and one for every [[retired]] row that is
# not in retired-grandfathered.txt, whose version is below the current
# version.Version: so a release always ships an alias deprecated before a
# later one retires it, and a deprecation and its retirement never ship in
# the same release.
